Looking at the plate, I see spinach leaves, shredded carrot, and torn pieces of fresh mozzarella. The portion looks like roughly 80-100 g of mozzarella, about 40 g of spinach, and about 30 g of carrot.

- Mozzarella at ~90 g and ~250 kcal per 100 g comes to about 225 kcal. If it is part-skim, it would be closer to 70 kcal per 28 g, so I'll settle on about 200 kcal.
- Spinach at 40 g is about 9 kcal.
- Carrot at 30 g is about 12 kcal.

That adds up to about 221 kcal, which I'll round to 220. The total mass is about 90 + 40 + 30 = 160 g.

{"kcal": 220, "mass_g": 160}
